teacherNote: Marked against: Drawing a correct labelled diagram showing the tower / shadow / and angle of elevation (1); Setting up the correct trigonometric relation tan 60° = h / 20 (1); Substituting tan 60° = √3 and calculating height h = 20√3 m (or 34.64 m) (1).
